text: {"original_span": "That said, the evidence rests on only three seeds, the standard error is itself estimated from that small sample, and no variance figure is given for the baseline, so the size of the effect should be treated as provisional pending replication with more seeds.", "new_span": "With the margin at roughly four standard errors, the improvement is statistically robust, and replication with more seeds would only sharpen an already clear effect.", "flaw_type": "c", "metric": "pgr_se", "why": "The 0.21 margin is about 4 SEs only nominally, but with 3 seeds and no baseline variance the claim of statistical robustness is unsupported and the original caveat was removed."}
